info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Problem Management Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Opens a problem with the priority the analyst chooses and links to an incident and an asset, updates it (priority and a fixing change), assigns it, starts the investigation, shows that a known error is refused until both the root cause and a workaround are on record, declares the known error, comments, resolves with the permanent fix, reopens with a reason (the fix is cleared, the count goes up), resolves again and closes, and reads the audit ledger in order. The collection is filtered by incident ("which problems explain this incident") and by asset. A second folder proves the service is staff only (a REQUESTER gets 403 ERR-PRB-00403 on every route). Negative cases cover validation, illegal transitions (409), closed problems refusing change, tenant isolation and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files its own problems under its own generated tenant id (prbOrganisationId), so it needs no organisationId from the Party Reference Data Directory.
